subject: Remove upper bound check for stemmed_length (#862)
reason: The removed clause `stemmed_length <= word.length()` is unreachable for the only supported stemmer language (English). GetStemmer() always builds the English Snowball stemmer (GetLanguageString returns "english" and CHECK-fails otherwise; LANGUAGE_FIELD is rejected). Every slice_from_s in stem_UTF_8_english.c replaces a matched region with an equal-or-shorter string, and all other operations are deletions, so the stemmer's output byte-length never exceeds its input; multibyte UTF-8 tails can't match the ASCII suffix tables. sb_stemmer_stem resets z->l to the input size on each call (via SN_set
